big: A mutual fund is simple. A PMS needs ₹50 lakh. Between them sits a newer product: the SIF. It comes from a fund house, under mutual fund rules, with a ₹10 lakh minimum, and it can take short positions.

lines: More flexible than a mutual fund, more regulated and accessible than a PMS or AIF. It has a factsheet, a riskometer and a trustee. The minimum is ₹10 lakh per investor across all SIF strategies of that fund house.
